other.name: MDOT MTA: free rides on MARC, Local Bus, Metro Subway, Light Rail, Commuter Bus and Mobility
other.where: All MTA service, including MARC's Odenton, BWI, Savage/Jessup and Laurel stations
other.offer: Free rides for all US military veterans, active-duty military and members of the National Guard and Reserves. Regular schedules.
other.note: Show one of three IDs: a DoD-issued ID (Armed Forces, Uniformed Services or Military Retiree), a VA-issued ID, or an MVA driver's license or state ID with the Veteran designation. A DD-214 is not on MTA's list. Metro (WMATA) and county buses are separate.

other.note: For the veteran or card holder only, not others in the car, unless the park charges per vehicle (then the vehicle fee is waived). Other facility charges still apply.

other.name: What's closed and open
other.where: Anne Arundel, Howard and Prince George's counties and the City of Laurel
other.offer: Federal offices are closed and there's no mail delivery. Anne Arundel County: county offices closed; public schools and libraries open; curbside trash and recycling on the normal schedule; only county bus routes 201, 202 (Arundel Mills-Odenton), 203 and the BWI Express run, and Call-N-Ride is closed. Howard County: county offices, 50+ centers, the animal shelter, local courts and county historic sites (except the B&O Ellicott City Station Museum) are closed; county parks, Robinson Nature Center, the North Laurel, Gary J. Arthur and Roger Carter community centers and Alpha Ridge Landfill are open; RTA buses run their regular weekday schedule; every Howard County Library System branch is closed. Prince George's County (most of Laurel): county offices, public schools and libraries closed; trash collected; county buses run except route P78. City of Laurel: city and passport offices closed; Wednesday trash, recycling and compost pickup moves to Thursday 12 Nov, and there's no bulky-item or yard-debris pickup on 11 Nov. MARC runs full service on all three lines; Metrorail runs its weekend schedule, 5 AM-midnight.
other.note: Howard County public schools weren't confirmed for 2026: check before going. Howard County's notice names two different days for trash pickup, so check before setting bins out.
